baseline_builder_issues.evidence: Every turn this caused is now a hit (girls-night t1, night-out-40s t3, right-now t2 and t3). No happy hour or trivia row is offered as a night out. Steel Wheel Tavern is named in 1 conversation, down from 13.

baseline_builder_issues.issue: Every-word keyword matching and the events/places split
baseline_builder_issues.evidence: The old failure is gone: girls-night t1 and new-in-town t2 are hits, 'run club' finds run clubs, one search returns both events and places. Two retrieval misses remain, both from the keyword the agent chose: access t2 ('live show' missed the accessible Mozart concert) and cultural t1 (searched 'menorah lighting', so 'Jewbilation: A Hanukah Variety Show' in Teaneck still isn't offered).

`near` is passed in 13 conversations and every 'about N minutes' in the run matches the tool's estimate for the nearest town named. right-now t3 leads with Englewood (was Mahwah); toddler and teens no longer get table-order rows. Residue: 'about 5 minutes from both of you' for two towns (girls-night t1), and cultural t1 leads with a town 20 minutes away.

baseline_builder_issues.issue: 'Nothing in the window' ignores the next match
baseline_builder_issues.evidence: freestyle-80s t1 leads with Freestyle Flashback on Jan 16 as an other-date pick; creative-night t1 offers the Nov 20 pottery night when Friday has none; nye t2 and toddler t2 are hits.

baseline_builder_issues.issue: The agent doesn't know what time it is
baseline_builder_issues.evidence: right-now t1 passes after: '21:00', the ended Twin Door set is no longer offered, music-genres t1 correctly says a 7-10pm night is 'happening right now', pushback t3 says a class 'runs until 10 PM tonight'. Not exercised: open_now still uses the real clock, not a time the person states.

Fixed: the teen's age is saved; 'near/from' towns are saved for girls-night, toddler-weekday, senior-mom and wife-40th; nothing about the visiting mother or the 40th; 'wheelchair accessible venues' and 'free or cheap, about $20 for two' replace the old wording. Not fixed: four conversations saved nothing (latin-dance, noraebang, right-now, foodie-events; the first three did save facts in the baseline), the town is not saved for 'near englewood', 'near teaneck' or 'in or near hackensack', and single-45 saved 'singles events'.

baseline_builder_issues.issue: Follow-ups can't see earlier tool results
baseline_builder_issues.evidence: Works: toddler t3, freestyle-80s t3, creative-night t2, budget-two t2 and right-now t2 answer from saved rows with no search. Side effects: saved rows drop requirement notes (teens t2 offers a library party without 'registration required'; nye t3 misses 'payment is due in full to reserve'), and the digest let the agent skip a search it needed (freestyle-80s t2, tribute bands).

Fixed: Friday email at most once per conversation; no 'text me Thursday' on a Thursday; replies with two or more questions down from 8 to 2; no reply over 750 characters (longest 725, mean 516 vs 520); Steel Wheel overuse gone. New or remaining: 'the listing says' wording in 12 replies (was 2); the canned 'Text me next week, I'll know more' in 6 replies, twice running in event-facts; unsupported colour in 5 conversations; rain-plan t3 still says a show this Saturday will 'sell fast closer to Thanksgiving'.

dj-promoter t1 and t3 call note_for_research with the lead (the same lead twice). Whether anything is stored can't be judged from the transcript; the builder reports the table doesn't exist yet. No sign of misses being captured.

baseline_research_gaps.topic: DJ, dance and Latin nights for 30s-40s
baseline_research_gaps.evidence: night-out-40s, girls-night, latin-dance and pushback now draw on CZEN, Zina's, The Craftsman, The Roosevelt, Life After, Shawn's Crazy Saloon, the Williams Center and Havana Dance Center, with named DJs. Left over: crowd notes for the Latin venues (latin-dance t3); hookah and rooftops weren't asked in this run.

baseline_research_gaps.topic: Practical details on rows we already have
baseline_research_gaps.evidence: New rows carry set times and prices (Brvsh Cul7ur3, Zina's, Williams Center, Pinot's Palette). Still missing in this run: karaoke room rates, Sky Zone GLOW and Holiday Bowl NYE prices, start times at Don Coqui and The Roosevelt, Dracula's showtime, hours for Khyber, SideBar, LaTour and Sook Pastry, parking and rain plan for the Ridgewood tree lighting.

Senior daytime programs are in (senior-mom t1 and t2 are hits) and the Barrymore Film Center's rows are tagged wheelchair accessible (access t1 is a hit). No access data for any other venue, no parking notes, nothing on quiet restaurants.
Pickleball, two run clubs, a Ramapo-chapter group hike and a board game night all answered (active t1-t3, new-in-town t2). No Sunday-morning yoga.

baseline_research_gaps.topic: Live music by genre, and music at brunch
baseline_research_gaps.evidence: Line dancing, live country, punk, a metal cover band, disco, Friday jazz and a DJ brunch are all answered (music-genres t1-t2, freestyle-80s, memory-carry, girls-night t3).
Library story times across towns, teen-tagged events and family NYE are in (toddler-weekday 3 hits, teens t1 and t3, nye t2). The rows' registration and residents-only notes need to reach the reply.
Paint and sip, BYOB workshops, pottery, kids' art and a gallery all answered (creative-night 3 hits, first-date t2).

baseline_research_gaps.topic: Private party venues and DJs for hire
baseline_research_gaps.evidence: wife-40th: two honest misses and a partial. Lookup for private room/dining/banquet/buyout still returns only karaoke rooms and kids' party places.
Tastings, a chocolate expo, cooking classes with wine pairing and wine tasting rooms are in (foodie-events t1 is a hit). No restaurant week; festivals are thin.

Only the Ramsey Farmers Market rows mention dogs. dog-owner t2 and t3 are the same honest misses.

baseline_research_gaps.evidence: Galleries: in (first-date t2). Garfield: a few library rows, and budget-two was answered from Rutherford. Simbang Gabi: still nothing (cultural t2).

issues_for_builder.title: Details land on the wrong thing or lose their conditions: a price from another event, and requirement notes dropped
issues_for_builder.evidence: (a) rain-plan t1, the run's one wrong turn: search_places({"good_for":"rainy day","keyword":"climbing"}) now returns upcoming_events with the place; the reply says 'Day passes run about $21 with shoes and harness' for Saturday, which is the cost of 'Climb/R: Tuesday Climbing Partner Meetup at GOAT' ('$18 discounted day pass, $21 with shoes and harness... Tell the front desk you are there for the meetup'). The gym's own price is '$$'. (b) shapeEvent's short() cuts `about` at 200 characters, and the requirement is usually the last sentence: toddler t2 offers 'Music Storytime with Mr. Corbitt' without '(registration required)'; active t3 gives the ADK hike without 'Advance registration is required and rain or snow cancels'; music-genres t3 leaves out 'RSVP online to lock in a slot'. (c) The recall digest keeps only date, time and cost for rows not yet named, so teens t2 offers the Teen Hunger Games Party with no mention of 'Registration required' (it is a tag on the row) and nye t3 misses 'payment is due in full to reserve'.
issues_for_builder.fix: Give each shaped row a short `needs` field built from tags and text (registration required, residents only, ages or grades, 21+, RSVP, pay in full, sold out) that is never truncated and is kept in the digest. Mark the cost on upcoming_events and happening_here rows as belonging to that event. Prompt: a price, time or age rule belongs to the row it is on; say registration or residents-only whenever `needs` has it.
issues_for_builder.impact: 6 turns; clears the wrong turn (rain-plan goes from 50 to about 84) and lifts the Fit cap in three conversations.

issues_for_builder.title: A badly chosen keyword still misses rows we hold, and saved rows let the agent skip a search it needs
issues_for_builder.evidence: access t2: search_events({"keyword":"live show","crowd":"wheelchair accessible","limit":10}) -> 'none of the live shows this weekend say anything about step-free access'; the data has 'Mozart! performed by the Adelphi Orchestra | fort-lee | Sun Nov 15 4 PM | wheelchair accessible' in the building it recommended one turn earlier. cultural t1: asked for 'hanukkah events or menorah lightings near teaneck', searched search_events({"keyword":"menorah lighting","near":"Teaneck",...}) only, without include_date_tba; the reply leads with River Vale (about 20 minutes) and omits Teaneck's own undated lighting and 'Jewbilation: A Hanukah Variety Show | teaneck | Dec 9'. freestyle-80s t2: asked for a tribute band, made no tool call, and offered cover bands while 25+ tribute nights sit in the next three weeks. memory-carry t1: 'wine bars' got no pick though wine tasting rooms are now in the data.
issues_for_builder.fix: Make an access need in `crowd` a filter (and say when it emptied the list). Expand 'live show' to concert, theater, comedy, live music. Prompt: when they name two things ('hanukkah events or menorah lightings'), search both words; for holiday asks pass include_date_tba so the home town's undated event shows; a new thing asked for needs a new search even when saved rows exist.
issues_for_builder.impact: 4 turns (access t2 becomes a hit; the other three become better hits).

issues_for_builder.title: Memory is still uneven: four conversations saved nothing, 'near X' towns are missed, one borderline fact
issues_for_builder.evidence: facts after is [] for latin-dance (bachata, reggaeton), noraebang (karaoke, late nights), right-now (live music, games) and foodie-events (food events, new restaurants); the first three saved facts in the baseline run, so the new prompt made this less reliable, not more. No remember call appears in any of those twelve turns. Town not saved for 'near englewood' (right-now), 'near teaneck' (cultural), 'in or near hackensack' (first-date) or 'fort lee or palisades park' (noraebang), though the prompt now says near/from names the town. single-45 saved {"kind":"interest","fact":"singles events"} for someone who said they are newly single.
issues_for_builder.fix: Run the existing reflect pass at the end of a conversation to catch tastes and towns the live turn skipped. In the prompt, tie the save to the first search ('send remember in the same step as your first search'). Decide whether 'singles events' is an acceptable interest or should be stored as 'meeting new people'.
issues_for_builder.impact: No outcome changes; Fit in 6 conversations.

issues_for_builder.title: Unsupported colour, 'the listing says', and one canned line
issues_for_builder.evidence: Unsupported or stretched: girls-night t1 'about 5 minutes from both of you' (the tool's estimate from Paramus is about 10); latin-dance t3 'Zina's and Don Coqui both just say 21+' (Don Coqui's rows give no age limit); first-date t2 'It's quiet and easy to talk there'; memory-carry t2 'Take the 9:30 set if you'd like it a little calmer'; budget-two t1 'a fun crowd', t3 'both on the Bergen County Line' (true, not from the data); rain-plan t3 'should sell fast closer to Thanksgiving' for a show this Saturday. Source talk: 'the listing' appears in 12 replies across 7 conversations (2 before), e.g. 'The listing pegs the crowd at 40+', 'The listings don't say anything about parking'. Canned: 'Text me next week, I'll know more' in 6 replies, twice running in event-facts.
issues_for_builder.fix: approx_drive_min should say which town it is measured from, and the prompt should forbid 'from both of you' unless both are returned. Add 'listing' to the banned words and give a friend's phrasing ('they don't say', 'their page says 40+'). Offer two or three check-back wordings and don't repeat one within a conversation.
issues_for_builder.impact: Honesty back to 4 in five conversations (about 5 points each).

issues_for_builder.title: Slow replies, and a lead tool nobody has seen write
issues_for_builder.evidence: Four replies took over 10 seconds (one in the baseline): budget-two t3 14.4s, past the 12-second SMS webhook limit, with only update_profile and remember calls; budget-two t2 11.6s with no tool call at all; music-genres t2 11.8s; memory-carry t4 10.2s. dj-promoter logged the same lead in t1 and t3; the builder's notes say the table it writes to doesn't exist yet.
issues_for_builder.fix: Trace the two slow no-search turns (BUDDY_DEBUG=1) to see whether the model round or the save path is slow, and enforce a reply deadline under 12 seconds. Apply the research_tickets migration, de-duplicate leads per conversation, and re-run dj-promoter to confirm a row is written.
issues_for_builder.impact: No score change under this rubric; a 14-second reply is a dropped text in production.

gaps_for_research.topic: Practical details still missing on rows we hold: prices, start times, hours, parking, rain plans, booking terms
gaps_for_research.what_we_had: No price for Sky Zone GLOW, Holiday Bowl's NYE packages or any karaoke room; no start time for DJ nights at Don Coqui or The Roosevelt, or for Dracula; no hours for Khyber, SideBar, LaTour, Sook Pastry, Big SNOW; no parking or rain plan for the Ridgewood tree lighting, whose date is still unconfirmed.
gaps_for_research.sources_that_would_help: Venue booking pages and a phone call for prices and room rates; Google Business hours; the Ridgewood Chamber for the lighting's date, parking and rain plan.

gaps_for_research.topic: Private party venues and DJs for hire
gaps_for_research.what_we_had: Karaoke party rooms (Rock 21 to 30, Volume Up to 50), Rojo's private-event space from the issue, and now a dozen named working DJs with no booking details.
gaps_for_research.sources_that_would_help: Restaurant private-dining pages, catering halls and lounges with capacity, minimums and dance-floor notes; booking contacts for the DJs already named in event rows (The Salsa Connexion, Sound Illusion DJs).

gaps_for_research.topic: Accessibility beyond one venue, parking, and quiet places to eat
gaps_for_research.what_we_had: The Barrymore Film Center is tagged wheelchair accessible with elevators and no stairs; nothing for bergenPAC, HACPAC, Debonair Music Hall, the Williams Center or any restaurant. No parking notes. No noise or lunch-service data.
gaps_for_research.sources_that_would_help: Each theater's accessibility page, Google wheelchair and parking attributes, restaurant hours and a 'quiet' note from reviews.

gaps_for_research.topic: Dog-friendly breweries and patios, pet events
gaps_for_research.what_we_had: Dog parks and trails, plus the Ramsey Farmers Market (dogs on a short leash). No brewery, patio or restaurant with a dog note; no pet photo or adoption events.
gaps_for_research.sources_that_would_help: Brewery and restaurant sites, BringFido, Google 'dogs allowed', pet stores, shelters and malls in December.

gaps_for_research.topic: Single remaining asks: crowd notes for Latin venues, Simbang Gabi, restaurant week, Sunday yoga, hockey
gaps_for_research.what_we_had: Zina's and Don Coqui rows without crowd notes; no Simbang Gabi; no restaurant week; yoga only on weekday evenings and in chairs; no hockey games.
gaps_for_research.sources_that_would_help: Venue socials for crowd and dress; parish bulletins in Bergenfield, Dumont and Teaneck in early December; Chamber restaurant-week announcements; yoga studio weekend schedules; high school and club hockey schedules from the Ice House and Mackay rinks.

gaps_for_research.topic: Data quality in the new rows: duplicates with different prices and times, unverified standing schedules
gaps_for_research.what_we_had: The same event entered two or three times with different details: Pre-Dating speed dating Nov 24 at $29 and at $46.33 (the reply said 'about $29-46'), The Nerds at Gerry's Place at 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM, Come From Away three times, Freestyle Flashback twice, Board Game Night twice, the Yiddish concert twice. Rustica Lounge's weekly nights are unverified standing schedules, and the agent led a first date with one.
gaps_for_research.sources_that_would_help: A merge pass on venue + date before import, keeping the richer row and reconciling price and time against the ticket page; a call to Rustica to confirm its schedule.
